# Fonts

OpenMiles bundles two fonts so the app never downloads anything at runtime:

- **Inter** (body text), from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter
- **Space Grotesk** (numbers and headings), from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/spacegrotesk

Both are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The license texts are in this folder.
The font files are in `app/src/main/res/font/`.
